=== search all class files for github packages / registry host ===
./io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/Common_conventions_gradle$6$1.class:
.amazonaws.com
s3.eu
urbo-maven
./io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/Artifact_gradle$2$1$1.class:
urbo-maven
=== END ===

observation.command: cd /tmp/logic-extract && echo "=== search all class files for github packages / registry host ==="; for f in $(find . -name "*.class"); do r=$(grep -aoE "maven\.pkg\.github\.com|npm\.pkg\.github\.com|github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|io\.swcode\.urbo\.buildlogic|urbo-maven|\.amazonaws\.com|s3\.eu" "$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u); [ -n "$r" ] && echo "$f:" && echo "$r"; done; echo "=== END ==="
